title: 第十一章  若有半句假话，天打雷劈！
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

传旨太监口谕一到，林澈与月璇玑即刻动身。

穿过皇城，两个行至金殿外。

月璇玑看着身前的林澈压低声音说：

“现在走还来得及，你要是进了这个门，死路一条。”

说实话，月璇玑是真的不想林澈死。

只是想毁了这门婚，林家毕竟是国公府。

还有就是担心林澈有后手，毕竟这几天他的变化实在太大！

万一在父皇，母后面前出了差错可不是闹着玩的！

林澈斜了她一眼，嘴角一撇：

“别在这儿猫哭耗子了，和离是你提的，威胁我签字的是你，现在装什么好人？”

“你...！”

月璇玑气得差点咬碎后槽牙：

“我可怜你！懂吗？可怜！”

“哦，那可真是多谢公主殿下的怜悯了。”

林澈阴阳怪气地拱了拱手：

“不过您这怜悯还是留着自己用吧，我看您更需要。”

月璇玑气得袖子一甩，转身就走：

“你爱死不死，关我屁事！”

金殿内。

林澈的老爹林龙虎跪在地上，不断求情。

“陛下！都怪犬子顽劣，臣教导无方！”

“求陛下开恩啊！”

林龙虎心里苦啊。

儿子被人陷害？

他还不敢明说，只能打碎牙往肚子里咽！

乞求陛下开恩....

皇帝月天坐在龙椅上看不出喜怒道；

“璇玑公主是朕最疼爱的女儿。”

月天帝的声音不大，却威严十足：

“朕把公主交给你们林家，三年了，你儿子不好好待她，如今还与丫鬟私通....”

“罪无可恕。”

话音刚落，殿内几位老臣齐刷刷看向林龙虎，那眼神，就跟看一只待宰的鸡似的。

“林国公，你们林家这也太过分了吧！”

“辜负皇恩，罪加一等！”

“公主何等尊贵，岂能受此大辱！”

几位大臣你一言我一语，唾沫星子都快把林龙虎给淹了。

月天帝抬手，示意大家安静，然后缓缓说道：

“等林澈和璇玑到了，朕将查明真相！”

“若林澈真与宫女有私便当堂处死，林家罚俸十年...”

林龙虎听到这句话，整个人像是被雷劈了一样，浑身一哆嗦，直接瘫在了地上。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

As soon as the eunuch's oral instructions arrived, Lin Che and Yue Xuanji set off immediately.

Passing through the imperial city, the two of them arrived outside the Golden Palace.

Yue Xuanji looked at Lin Che in front of her and lowered her voice and said:

"It's still too late to leave now. If you enter this door, you will die."

To be honest, Yue Xuanji really didn't want Lin Che to die.

I just want to ruin this marriage. After all, the Lin family is the Duke's residence.

Also, she was worried that Lin Che might have a back-up plan. After all, he had changed so much in the past few days!

It’s no joke if something goes wrong in front of my father and mother!

Lin Che glanced at her sideways and curled her lips:

"Stop being a bitch here. It was you who proposed the divorce, and it was you who threatened me to sign. Why are you pretending to be a good person now?"

"You...!"

Yue Xuanji was so angry that she almost broke her back teeth:

"I pity you! Do you understand? Pity you!"

"Oh, thank you very much for your mercy, Princess."

Lin Che arched her hands in an angry tone:

"But you should keep this mercy for yourself. I think you need it more."

Yue Xuanji was so angry that she tossed her sleeves, turned around and left:

"Whether you love me or not is none of my business!"

Inside the Golden Palace.

Lin Che's father, Lin Longhu, knelt on the ground and kept begging for mercy.

"Your Majesty! It's all because of the naughty dog and the incompetence of my teachings!"

"Your Majesty, please have mercy!"

Lin Longhu felt miserable.

My son was framed?

He didn't dare to say it clearly, so he could only break his teeth and swallow it in his stomach!

I beg your majesty for mercy...

Emperor Yue Tian was sitting on the dragon chair and could not tell whether he was happy or angry;

"Princess Xuanji is my most beloved daughter."

Emperor Yue Tian’s voice was not loud, but full of majesty:

"I gave the princess to your Lin family. It has been three years since your son treated her well, and now he is having an affair with the maid..."

"There is no forgiveness for sin."

As soon as he finished speaking, several veterans in the palace looked at Lin Longhu, as if they were looking at a chicken waiting to be slaughtered.

"Lin Guogong, your Lin family has gone too far!"

"If you fail to live up to the emperor's favor, your crime will be increased!"

"The princess is so noble, how can she suffer such a great humiliation!"

The few ministers said something to each other, and Lin Longhu was almost drowned in saliva.

Emperor Yue Tian raised his hand to signal everyone to be quiet, and then said slowly:

"When Lin Che and Xuanji arrive, I will find out the truth!"

"If Lin Che really has an affair with the palace maid, he will be executed in court, and the Lin family will fine him ten years of salary..."

When Lin Longhu heard this, he felt as if he had been struck by lightning. He trembled all over and collapsed on the ground.
